title: Mexican Mushroom and Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious Mexican-inspired dish featuring sautéed mushrooms and pilaf rice. Serve as a main course or side dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked pilaf, cumin, and paprika to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
